definitions.explanation: The quality of being young or childlike, whether an endearing innocence or an immaturity in attitude. The noun form of {幼|おさな}い.

examples.japanese: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{幼|おさな}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: A youthful look still remains on her face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{幼|おさな}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I sensed a certain immaturity in his way of thinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幼|おさな}さ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{素直|すなお}さ→素直さ：22526_sunaosa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表|あらわ}れていた→表れる：14276_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: His words showed both immaturity and honesty at the same time.

notes:
The noun form of the i-adjective ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧ (young, childish), made with the {〜さ} suffix. It can be positive (endearing innocence, a youthful appearance) or negative (immaturity of thought), depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼|おさな}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: retain a childlike quality
- {幼|おさな}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: sense immaturity / youthfulness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {若|わか}さ: youth — about being young in years; {幼|おさな}さ suggests something more childlike or unfinished
